title: Dragon Epic — 1-minute photoreal short, family hero face
dt_project: dragon-1a (scene 1A I2V), dragon-1b (scene 1B stills, Kevin, 5 refs), dragon-1b-tests (1B v1/v2)

still.scene1a_prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm, high above an open ocean at sunset, the sun low on the horizon and half-sunk, sky in orange, magenta and deep violet, backlit. A massive dark reddish-brown dragon with matte ridged scales, a long tapered neck, bat-like wing membranes with visible bone struts and torn trailing edges, a row of curved horns sweeping back from the skull and amber eyes flies left to right across the frame, wings spread wide, a small armored rider seated at the base of its neck. Far behind it a second dragon, smaller and soft in the sea haze. A long path of sun glitter on the water below, thin streaked clouds lit from beneath, volumetric warm light, photorealistic, highly detailed, shallow depth of field on the distant dragon, no text.

i2v.prompt: per shot — one camera move + one subject action
i2v.scene1a_prompt: the dragon hangs in the air with slow deep wing beats, its body and head steady in the frame, the rider sitting still, the distant dragon slowly beating its wings in the haze, sun glitter shimmering on the sea, clouds drifting very slowly, subtle motion, cinematic, photorealistic

post.upscale: scripts/upscale_4k.sh — Real-ESRGAN x4plus ncnn, tile 128, → 3840x2160 HEVC 10-bit 40 Mbps (5.6 min/clip)
post.music: The Dragon's Breath — ONECinematicStudio, Pixabay (cdn.pixabay.com/audio/2026/05/04/audio_505690c98b.mp3), 2:40; scene 1A preview uses peak section from 135 s, 0.3 s fade in / 1 s fade out, vol 0.9. Final film: full track + SFX (TBD)

notes: Plan page: wiki/dragon-epic-plan.md. Experiments E1–E7 must pass before rendering the shot list. Needs face photos in projects/dragon_epic/raw/face/. Delivery is 4K UHD. Scene 1A: v1 ghosted (push-in + translation), v2 noise (refiner 50%), v3 clean (10%, articulation-only prompt).
